definitions.explanation: A series of lectures or classes on a particular subject, often offered by educational institutions or cultural centers.

examples.japanese: {講座|こうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{込|こ}む。
{料理|りょうり}{講座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01237_ukeru⟧。
{講座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

notes:
{講座|こうざ} refers to a course or lecture series.

COMMON TYPES:
- {通信|つうしん}{講座|こうざ}: correspondence course
- {公開|こうかい}{講座|こうざ}: public lecture series
- オンライン{講座|こうざ}: online course
- {入門|にゅうもん}{講座|こうざ}: introductory course

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講座|こうざ}を{受|う}ける (to take a course)
- {講座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}く (to offer a course)
- {講座|こうざ}に{参加|さんか}する (to participate in a course)

NOTE: Do not confuse with {口座|こうざ} (bank account), which has the same reading.
